blockerDefinitions.cstring-termination-or-capacity-policy: The ABI needs a reviewed distinction between bounded byte count, writable capacity, and C-string termination on success and failure.
blockerDefinitions.handle-provenance-or-engine-context: The ABI consumes or returns an engine handle whose provenance, context, ownership, nullability, or teardown contract is not encoded by the arena.
blockerDefinitions.hash-buffer-runtime-and-allocation-evide: The bounded hash-buffer shape still lacks a generated wrapper with packaged-link, parity, warmed-allocation, and runtime-behavior evidence.
blockerDefinitions.opaque-byte-pointee-unit-or-lifetime: The void pointer's pointee unit, mutability, returned lifetime, allocation source, or ownership is not fully represented by the mechanical span shape.
blockerDefinitions.record-layout-or-borrowed-record-lifetim: The ABI crosses a record pointer whose exact layout, nested fields, borrowed lifetime, or engine-context relationship is not yet verified.
blockerDefinitions.template-element-layout-or-specializatio: The template element type or specialization is unresolved, so the arena cannot prove element size, alignment, copying, or native linkage.
